interpretation: Advancing motion event timestamps demonstrate sensor delivery during this capture; merely listing a sensor does not.
An unsubscribed sensor is not expected to deliver new events; old gyro timestamps after AR closes do not indicate failure.
Camera service process survival and a readable dump do not prove preview frames or camera/IMU synchronization.
No active camera client is normal when no application is using the camera; it is not a camera crash.
ARCore synchronization warnings do not alone prove sensor failure or calibration damage.
No matching crash line means none in the available current game-process buffer, not that no historical crash occurred.
Calibration, visual camera pose response, and physical world-anchor stability need an observed AR run.
